name: Salt Lake County Internships for High School Students
what_you_do: County offices hire interns for work that depends on the office. The county lists some internships for school credit and some that pay. Each job post names the duties.
who_can_apply: Students in high school, career and trade programs. College and graduate students can apply too. The program page names no age limit.
pay_detail: Some are paid and some are for school credit. Each job post says which.
duration: Varies. It depends on the office and its budget.
deadline_text: No dates are listed on the program page. Check the county job board for current posts.
how_to_apply: Search the county job board for posts with Internship as the position type. If none fits, call Human Resources at 385-468-0570. The program page says unpaid interns take part in an educational or academic program.
notes: Each job post says whether it is paid or for school credit. Read each post for its own rules.
